title: Inventory count is 72h old: investigate
description: Usaquén's milk count has not been updated for 3 days while sales kept flowing. Trusting the record says buy nothing; adjusting for sales since the count says buy 240. The data cannot support either decision.
rationale: inventory updated 72h ago > 24h freshness limit -> stale
as recorded: available 420; net = 300 + 120 - 420 - 0 = 0 -> nothing to buy
sales since the count (days -3..-1): 3 x 60 = 180 -> plausible available 420 - 180 = 240
the decision flips between REJECT and buying 240 depending on data we cannot trust -> INVESTIGATE
information that would change the decision: a fresh cycle count of LECHE-ALQ-1L at BOG-02
no PO may be created; the run ends escalated with an information request
